ifc_patch.fallback.source_changed: Patch not used: the source file changed on disk or cannot be read. The file was rewritten from the model.
ifc_patch.fallback.sources: Patch not used: the project does not have exactly one source. The file was rewritten from the model.
ifc_patch.fallback.schema: Patch not used: the source file's schema is not supported. The file was rewritten from the model.
ifc_patch.fallback.structure: Patch not used: the source file's structure could not be trusted. The file was rewritten from the model.
ifc_patch.fallback.edit: Patch not used: an edit cannot be applied safely to the source file. The file was rewritten from the model.
ifc_patch.reason.schema: The source file's schema cannot hold this edit; the element stays as in the source
ifc_patch.reason.prop: This property edit cannot be expressed in the source file; the value stays as in the source
ifc_patch.reason.no_export: This new element has no representation in IFC
ifc_patch.reason.link: The element is in the file, but a link to its material or type is not written; it is listed as not written
ifc_patch.drop_done: Pending links dropped: {n}; they are no longer retried
ifc_patch.fallback.building: Patch not used: a new level needs exactly one building in the source file, and it has none or several. The file was rewritten from the model.
ifc_patch.fallback.types: Patch not used: levels, types or materials changed since the import, and the patch cannot write those. The file was rewritten from the model.
ifc_patch.fallback.zipped: Patch not used: a zipped source file cannot be patched. The file was rewritten from the model.
ifc_patch.fallback.source_kept: The source file was not overwritten: this save could not be trusted to replace it. This save is a copy beside it.
ifc_patch.fallback.nested: Patch not used: a new element has nested parts (such as ports), which the patch cannot write. The file was rewritten from the model.
ifc_patch.fallback.shared_part: Patch not used: a part of an edited stair or ramp is also used by another element or relation, which the patch cannot account for. The file was rewritten from the model.
